technical.summary: Strong trend structure (ADX, EMA alignment, Ichimoku) offset by bearish momentum divergence (stoch cross, MACD histogram, RSI stalling) and Bollinger Band squeeze limiting volatility expansion.

fundamental.summary: EIX shows no insider buying conviction, no institutional accumulation signals, zero government contract activity, no lobbying engagement, and minimal retail interest; earnings in 11 days present elevated volatility risk with insufficient fundamental support.

sentiment.summary: Extreme market fear (26/100) presents contrarian buy opportunity, but congressional activity is minimal and stale with no recent conviction signals.

risk.summary: Crisis VIX (418.4), flat yield curve, rising dollar, and earnings in 11 days create a highly adverse macro backdrop for EIX.

debate.key_bull_argument: Strong trend structure (ADX, EMA 50/200 alignment, Supertrend bullish) with contrarian buy signal in extreme fear zone (VIX 418.4) offers asymmetric risk/reward if macro stabilizes.
debate.key_bear_argument: Bearish momentum divergence (stoch cross, negative MACD histogram, RSI stalling, price below EMA-9/Hull), zero fundamental conviction, earnings volatility in 11 days, and crisis macro backdrop (VIX, rising dollar, flat yield curve) outweigh trend structure.

decision.entry_rationale: Strong trend structure (ADX, EMA 50/200 alignment) and contrarian fear-zone signal offer technical appeal. However, bearish momentum divergence, zero fundamental conviction, and earnings volatility in 11 days create asymmetric downside risk that outweighs entry quality.
decision.primary_risk: Earnings announcement in 11 days combined with crisis macro backdrop (VIX 418.4, rising dollar, flat yield curve) and stalled momentum (stoch bearish cross, negative MACD histogram, RSI not rising) creates high probability of adverse volatility spike.
decision.agent_agreement: strong — all agents aligned on bear case; technical trend structure insufficient to overcome fundamental weakness and macro headwinds
decision.portfolio_note: Already holding 149 positions in Utilities sector with existing EIX position; concentration risk and sector saturation argue against adding exposure.
